segments.name: Banking
segments.description: Community bank subsidiary offering traditional banking, trust, asset management and insurance services to individuals and businesses in northeastern and eastern Pennsylvania.
segments.evidence: The Bank has offered a full range of traditional banking services since it commenced operations in 1903.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the bank for traditional banking services, trust services, and alternative financial, insurance and asset management products.
revenueModel.evidence: The Bank has a personal and corporate trust department and also provides alternative financial and insurance products with asset management services.
